justification.statement: an orbit comes before every orbit its seed's collateral moves
justification.text: Placing an orbit releases the orbits its collateral moves; repeatedly placing the first listed row with no unplaced predecessor gives an order in which every collateral falls on a later orbit. The rows are the seed atlas's.

steps.check: Orbit 30 is in orbit 26's collateral, so 30 has one predecessor, 26.
The first listed row with no unplaced predecessor is orbit 26.
Placing 26 releases 30, which is placed next: the order is [26, 30].
Every row is placed: no cycle.
